Job Description - Digital Technology Specialist - Software Engineering 
 
 Partner with the best 
 Reporting to Director - Digital Operations, the Application Operations Engineer of SAP Plant Maintenance & Customer Services module will be responsible for SAP solutions for all business processes around Maintenance and Repair business. The individual will collaborate with SAP Program & Operations teams across various P&L’s and geographical locations to promote process standardization, synergy and compliance with local and Global statutory regulations. Long term strategic planning & contribution to the overall governance and compliance strategy is key part of this role. 
 
 As a Digital Technology Specialist - Software Engineering: 
 Lead the delivery of integrated SAP solutions for multiple ERP projects across Baker Hughes businesses while working with Program Managers, functional owners, service providers and other members of SAP Dev ops team
 Owns complete Plant Maintenance & Customer Services module solutions for end-to-end business process, which includes prototyping, blueprinting, design, build, test, and documentation and post go-live support, including interfaces, cross module integration.
 Accountable for Plant Maintenance & Customer Services related interfaces with external system & cross module integration with other SAP modules
 Complete accountability of quality of solution delivered by program and operations team
 Drive SAP best practices standards across Baker Hughes SAP Landscape. Ensure efficient and maintainable solution.
 Proactively engage stakeholders to identify opportunities for business process optimization
 Ensure the delivery of Stat/SOX compliant business solutions
 Continuously monitor for new developments in SAP technology and explore the opportunities in ES SAP landscape for optimization of business process
 Maintain cross functional business process domain knowledge
 Implement industry best practices as deemed applicable to enhance capabilities and effectiveness
 Maintain effective relationships across a distributed functional and global team in matrix environment to build an integrated solution.
 Assist leadership team in building multi-year ERP vision/strategy for the organization by aligning SAP technology with business Goals 
 
 Fuel your passion 
 To be successful in this role you will:
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering/information technology and related fields 
 Minimum 6 years of experience in SAP ERP implementations out of which 5 years of experience in SAP PM and CS domain
 Proficiency in maintaining and uploading master data for repair such as Materials, Equipment’s, Functional Locations, Task Lists, Work Centers, Customers etc.
 Proficiency in intercompany processing through IDOC processing.
 Proficiency in handling the Field Repair Scenarios using resource related billing.
 Below skills are mandatory Proficiency in Reactive maintenance Processes
 Proficiency in Preventive maintenance Processes.
 Proficiency in Warranty Management processes
 Proficiency in Maintenance Plans Processes.
 Good Knowledge of different Material Movements involved in Equipment lifecycle management process
 Knowledge of Batch Job Processing and working on different enhancements in SAP PM area is required.
 
 Knowledge of S4 HANA PM and CS area is preferred. 
 Knowledge/experience of Sales and distribution is required  
 Knowledge/experience of Project System module is preferred. 
 Minimum two end-to-end projects in implementing SAP ERP 
 At least 1 years of functional experience in respective domains  
 
 Nice to have Skills: 
 Ability to quickly identify and analyze technical risks & impacts, define alternatives to remove technical roadblocks.
 Experience in leading globally distributed teams and working with multi-cultural environment
 Ability to manage multiple deliverables independently in a fast-paced ecosystem
 Strong written and oral communication skills
 Highly motivated, Self-starter
 Able to work with multicultural teams and able to cover different time zones
 Global rollout experience 
 
 Work in a way that works for you 
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
 
 
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Experienced Professional - Enterprise Applications Engineering
